name: S1-01 future wording 'now or in the future' → Yes
spec_quote: A question that says "now or in the future", "in the future", "ever", "after graduation" or "at any time" is the FUTURE question → Yes.

field.label: Do you now or in the future require visa sponsorship for employment?

name: S1-02 'to begin working' sponsorship question → No (NOW)
spec_quote: A question whose wording asks whether the candidate needs sponsorship "for this internship", "during the internship" or "to begin / start working" (and does NOT also say future / ever / after graduation / at any time / later / eventually) is the NOW question → No.

field.label: Will you require visa sponsorship to begin working in this internship?

name: S1-03 'eligible WITHOUT sponsorship for this internship' opposite wording → Yes
spec_quote: "Are you eligible to work ... WITHOUT sponsorship for this internship?" is the opposite wording → Yes.

field.label: Are you eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship for this internship?

name: S1-04 'at any time in the future' → Yes
spec_quote: A question that says "now or in the future", "in the future", "ever", "after graduation" or "at any time" is the FUTURE question → Yes.

field.label: Will you need sponsorship at any time in the future?

name: S1-05 'during the internship' → No (NOW)
spec_quote: A question whose wording asks whether the candidate needs sponsorship "for this internship", "during the internship" or "to begin / start working" (and does NOT also say future / ever / after graduation / at any time / later / eventually) is the NOW question → No.

field.label: Do you require visa sponsorship during the internship?

name: S1-06 'after graduation' → Yes
spec_quote: A question that says "now or in the future", "in the future", "ever", "after graduation" or "at any time" is the FUTURE question → Yes.

field.label: Will you require sponsorship after graduation?

name: S1-07 sponsorship question with no timing wording — ambiguous
spec_quote: A question whose wording asks whether the candidate needs sponsorship "for this internship", "during the internship" or "to begin / start working" ... is the NOW question → No. A question that says "now or in the future", "in the future", "ever", "after graduation" or "at any time" is the FUTURE question → Yes.

field.label: Do you require visa sponsorship?

why: The spec only defines NOW (this internship / during / to begin) and FUTURE (now or in the future / ever / after graduation / at any time) wordings; a bare 'Do you require visa sponsorship?' has neither, so neither the No nor the Yes rule is stated to apply.

name: M1-01 checkbox 'Consent: marketing' → No (left unchecked)
spec_quote: A checkbox or Yes/No question that is a marketing opt-in → No (a checkbox with no options answers "No", which leaves it unchecked).

field.label: Consent: marketing

name: M1-02 'I consent to receive marketing communications' Yes/No → No
spec_quote: Marketing opt-ins include labels like "Consent: marketing", "I consent to receive marketing communications", "Opt in to marketing emails", "marketing purposes".

field.label: I consent to receive marketing communications

name: M1-03 'Opt in to marketing emails' checkbox → No
spec_quote: Marketing opt-ins include labels like "Consent: marketing", "I consent to receive marketing communications", "Opt in to marketing emails", "marketing purposes".

field.label: Opt in to marketing emails

name: M1-04 'marketing purposes' Yes/No → No
spec_quote: Marketing opt-ins include labels like "Consent: marketing", "I consent to receive marketing communications", "Opt in to marketing emails", "marketing purposes".

field.label: May we use your contact information for marketing purposes?

name: M1-05 privacy-only consent stays Yes
spec_quote: A consent to the processing of personal data / privacy notice that does not mention marketing stays Yes.

field.label: I consent to the processing of my personal data as described in the privacy notice

name: M1-06 data-processing consent that also mentions marketing → No
spec_quote: A consent to the processing of personal data / privacy notice that does not mention marketing stays Yes.

field.label: I consent to the processing of my personal data, including for marketing purposes

name: M1-07 privacy notice acknowledgement (no marketing mention) → Yes
spec_quote: A consent to the processing of personal data / privacy notice that does not mention marketing stays Yes.

field.label: I acknowledge that I have read the privacy notice and agree to the processing of my personal data

name: L1-01 place claim false, pick relocating option
spec_quote: an option saying the candidate already is / lives / is located / is based in a place ("Yes, I'm in SF / Bay Area ...", "Yes, I am located in Idaho ...", "I live in Boston") is false unless that place is Springfield. Instead the rule picks the option about relocating ("Yes, I'm willing to relocate ...", "planning on relocating") that is not negative

field.label: Are you willing to relocate for this internship?
options: Yes, I'm in the SF Bay Area and can start immediately
Yes, I'm willing to relocate to the Bay Area
No, I'm not willing to relocate

expect_value: Yes, I'm willing to relocate to the Bay Area

name: L1-02 only place claims + negative, no relocate option → unknown
spec_quote: an option saying the candidate already is / lives / is located / is based in a place ... is false unless that place is Springfield. ... No such option → status unknown.

field.label: Are you local to the Boston area?
options: No, I am not willing to relocate

name: L1-03 Springfield claim is true and may be picked
spec_quote: An option that claims Springfield is true and may be picked.

field.label: Do you currently live in the local area where this internship is based?
options: Yes, I'm located in Idaho and available immediately
Yes, I currently live in Springfield

expect_value: Yes, I currently live in Springfield

name: L1-04 option claiming no place works as before → Yes
spec_quote: Options that claim no place ("Yes", "Yes, I can commute") work as before (Yes).

field.label: Are you able to work on-site at our office?

name: L1-05 'planning on relocating' option chosen over 'based in Bay Area'
spec_quote: Instead the rule picks the option about relocating ("Yes, I'm willing to relocate ...", "planning on relocating") that is not negative (not "not willing", "unable", "cannot", "no").

field.label: This role is on-site in the Bay Area. What is your situation?
options: Yes, I am based in the Bay Area
Yes, I am planning on relocating to the Bay Area

expect_value: Yes, I am planning on relocating to the Bay Area

name: L1-06 all options are non-Springfield place claims → unknown
spec_quote: an option saying the candidate already is / lives / is located / is based in a place ... is false unless that place is Springfield. ... No such option → status unknown.

field.label: Are you in the San Francisco Bay Area?

name: L1-07 negative relocate option is not picked
spec_quote: Instead the rule picks the option about relocating ("Yes, I'm willing to relocate ...", "planning on relocating") that is not negative (not "not willing", "unable", "cannot", "no").

field.label: Would you relocate for this internship?
options: No, I am unable to relocate

name: P1-01 hourly + numbers only → 25
spec_quote: "numerical format", "numbers only", "digits only", "without special characters", "whole number" — gets "25" when the label says hourly / per hour

field.label: Hourly rate (numbers only)

name: P1-02 annual + numerical format → 52000
spec_quote: gets ... "52000" when it says annual / yearly / per year / salary (and not hourly)

field.label: Annual salary in numerical format

name: P1-03 yearly + digits only → 52000
spec_quote: A pay / salary / compensation text box (no options) whose label says the answer must be digits only — ... "digits only" ... — gets ... "52000" when it says annual / yearly / per year / salary (and not hourly).

field.label: Yearly compensation (digits only)

name: P1-04 salary + whole number, without special characters → 52000
spec_quote: "numerical format", "numbers only", "digits only", "without special characters", "whole number" — ... "52000" when it says annual / yearly / per year / salary (and not hourly).

field.label: Salary (whole number, without special characters)

name: P1-05 digits-only box naming neither hour nor year nor salary → unknown
spec_quote: A digits-only pay box naming neither hour nor year nor salary → unknown.

field.label: Compensation (digits only)

name: P1-06 pay text box with no digits-only wording → free-text answer
spec_quote: A pay text box with no digits-only wording → "Open / per internship program standard".

field.label: What are your pay expectations?

name: P1-07 hourly pay box without digits-only wording → free-text answer
spec_quote: A pay text box with no digits-only wording → "Open / per internship program standard".

field.label: Desired hourly pay

name: R1-01 reason for leaving → reason text, not employer
spec_quote: "Reason for leaving", "reason(s) for leaving any job(s) held ...", "Why did you leave your last job?" → the reason-for-leaving text above, never the employer name.

field.label: Reason for leaving your last job

expect_value: Fixed-term internship that ended as scheduled; returned to school full time.

name: R1-02 'Why did you leave your last job?' → reason text
spec_quote: "Reason for leaving", "reason(s) for leaving any job(s) held ...", "Why did you leave your last job?" → the reason-for-leaving text above, never the employer name.

field.label: Why did you leave your last job?

expect_value: Fixed-term internship that ended as scheduled; returned to school full time.

name: R1-03 current or most recent employer → employer name
spec_quote: "Current or most recent employer" still → "Example State University".

field.label: Current or most recent employer

name: R1-04 'reason(s) for leaving any job(s) held in the past' → reason text
spec_quote: "Reason for leaving", "reason(s) for leaving any job(s) held ...", "Why did you leave your last job?" → the reason-for-leaving text above, never the employer name.

field.label: Please list the reason(s) for leaving any job(s) held in the past

expect_value: Fixed-term internship that ended as scheduled; returned to school full time.
